name: orangu-god
description: Show each live Claude Code session of this machine in one pane. The pane tells you which session needs you now.

stuckAfterMin.title: Stuck after (minutes)
stuckAfterMin.description: A busy session with no transcript write for this many minutes shows as stuck.

staleAfterH.title: Stale after (hours)
staleAfterH.description: An idle session shows as stale after this many hours.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Set off to stop every spinner, pulse and sparkline of the pane.
